discovery_review: primary government pages and original PDF texts; page anchors where inspected

sources.title: Healdsburg original ALPR contracts, amendment and historical audits
sources.claim: Healdsburg publishes a dated catalogue of Flock agreements, an amendment, invoice, vendor history and multiple annual audit links.
sources.unresolved_question: Whether the publicly listed amendments supersede prior terms, whether identified invoices correspond to actual disbursements, and whether the indexed audits are complete.
sources.next_records_request: Obtain the executed agreement and amendment together with an official purchase-order/payment register.
sources.next_verification_action: Compare prior and revised vendor terms and publication dates; confirm any nonpublic parts are withheld under an identified exemption.

sources.title: 2025 ALPR annual audit identifies 299 camera-sharing agencies
sources.claim: The 2025 Flock audit reports sharing camera access with 299 agencies and says 2025 purge data is unavailable.
sources.unresolved_question: Names and effective dates of access relationships, audit method and completeness of purge records remain undetermined.
sources.next_records_request: Obtain dated aggregate sharing-permission reports and signed access agreements, without requesting vehicle movement histories.
sources.next_verification_action: Check audit-period definitions and compare subsequent annual audit disclosures rather than treating totals as instantaneous.

sources.title: Independent audit of Roseville Police Flock ALPR
sources.claim: The independently archived audit reports 30-day retention testing and describes Roseville Police's Flock fixed-location ALPR system.
sources.unresolved_question: Whether any material policy changes followed the audit or whether independent later audits contradict the observed period remains unknown.
sources.next_records_request: Obtain adopted ALPR policy versions and the next independent compliance audit, if available.
sources.next_verification_action: Check statutory retention carve-outs and effective dates before interpreting audit findings.

sources.title: Independent 2026 New Hope Flock ALPR audit
sources.claim: A Minnesota legislative-library original audit describes Flock use, 30-day retention and a query confirming no records older than 30 days during the audit.
sources.unresolved_question: Whether the same procedures apply after March 2026, or whether all preservation exceptions were captured, remains unknown.
sources.next_records_request: Request the policy version effective during the audited period and any subsequently adopted revisions.
sources.next_verification_action: Compare the next biennial audit on the same statutory criteria, not against an unrelated city.

sources.title: Tukwila April 2026 council Flock packet
sources.claim: The council packet describes a $101,000-per-year Flock agreement through 2028 and reports an updated Policy 429 dated April 13, 2026.
sources.unresolved_question: The final 2026 contract amendments, adopted provisions and actual current obligations require checking original post-April council decisions.
sources.next_records_request: Retrieve the final signed amendment, applicable Policy 429 versions and later council resolution minutes.
sources.next_verification_action: Separate April 2026 discussion-only agenda material from subsequently enacted council actions.

sources.title: October 2026 Comptroller order restricting state ALPR grant expenditures
sources.claim: The Comptroller announces an executive order restricting future state grants under that office from purchasing specified ALPR services, including Flock products.
sources.unresolved_question: Which grant streams are administered by this office, implementation terms and any exemptions beyond the announcement remain unverified.
sources.next_records_request: Obtain the signed executive order and later grant solicitation terms from the Comptroller's office.
sources.next_verification_action: Compare pre- and post-order awards within the Comptroller's jurisdiction, not all Texas grants.

sources.title: Town states January 2026 Flock termination vote
sources.claim: The town's official ALPR page states the January 15, 2026 council vote terminated the Flock contract and directed cameras offline.
sources.unresolved_question: Removal completion dates, vendor termination settlements and other nearby operators are not established by this page.
sources.next_records_request: Request final council minutes, signed cancellation notice and removal completion certifications.
sources.next_verification_action: Do not infer all ALPR cameras within town boundaries belonged to this town's contract.

sources.title: Asheville council action approves Flock contract termination
sources.claim: The city reports a 5–2 council approval directing termination of its Flock contract, suspension of data access and a policy review.
sources.unresolved_question: Whether vendor acknowledged termination, installed units were physically removed and final policy recommendations were adopted is not established.
sources.next_records_request: Obtain approved resolution text, delivered notice of termination and final action-response dates.
sources.next_verification_action: Verify actual removal and retention handling from original implementation records, not the directive alone.

sources.title: Mountain View reports termination after internal Flock data-access audit
sources.claim: City states its council voted unanimously to terminate the Flock pilot and reports a police audit identifying federal/state access inconsistent with city policy.
sources.unresolved_question: The exact audited access configuration, remedy confirmation and vendor accountability terms are not fully established by this announcement.
sources.next_records_request: Obtain the released aggregate policy-compliance audit, final council minutes and signed vendor termination documents.
sources.next_verification_action: Distinguish city-described policy violations from any independently adjudicated legal violation.

sources.title: Lafayette 2027 budget cuts Flock and city plans removal of 30 cameras
sources.claim: The city says its adopted 2027 budget removes Flock funding, directs immediate suspension and begins cancellation/removal of 30 contract cameras.
sources.unresolved_question: The final vendor termination agreement, actual removal inventory and regional/private cameras were not resolved by this statement.
sources.next_records_request: Obtain final budget ordinance, cancellation correspondence, vendor acknowledgments and aggregate removal milestones.
sources.next_verification_action: Do not classify cameras run by corporations or adjacent municipalities as Lafayette's equipment.

sources.title: Alexandria council-facing Flock ALPR response and audit disclosure
sources.claim: The police department's public question-and-answer page reports an internal ALPR-user auditing process completed every 30 days.
sources.unresolved_question: Independent completeness of auditing, vendor log reconciliation and prior policy changes remain unverified.
sources.next_records_request: Obtain audit procedures, aggregate audit-count summaries and adopted policy revision dates.
sources.next_verification_action: Avoid requesting individual vehicle observations or private search subject details.

sources.title: Monterey Park describes changes to required Flock search fields
sources.claim: Official FAQ explains that Flock search interface requirements added a mandatory offense code in December 2025 and a case/file number in March 2026.
sources.unresolved_question: The exact contemporaneous software specifications, city policy adoption dates and completeness of historical explanations are not independently verified.
sources.next_records_request: Obtain dated department policy versions and vendor change notices describing mandatory query metadata.
sources.next_verification_action: Do not interpret legacy blank reason fields as wrongdoing without contemporaneous requirements.

sources.title: October 2026 committee item proposes rescinding Flock ALPR subcontract
sources.claim: A city publication describes an October 21, 2026 committee item seeking to terminate the Flock technology subcontract.
sources.unresolved_question: Whether committee and council adopted a final termination and which signed subcontract applied are not established in the preview.
sources.next_records_request: Retrieve October 21 committee minutes, any subsequent council vote and current subcontract.
sources.next_verification_action: Do not promote a published agenda recommendation into an adopted cancellation.

sources.agency: San Mateo County Superior Court Civil Grand Jury
sources.title: Civil grand jury press advisory describes 2026 countywide ALPR oversight findings
sources.claim: The grand jury reports reviewing 17 law-enforcement agencies operating more than 580 ALPR cameras and identifies policy and audit oversight deficiencies.
sources.unresolved_question: Agency-specific findings and responses must be checked against the full report; the summary does not establish misconduct by every reviewed agency.
sources.next_records_request: Retrieve full report and each agency's signed response with final corrective-action dates.
sources.next_verification_action: Distinguish grand jury recommendations from documented implementation by each agency.
